update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.5 - Parent farming reliability, Quick Mode dialog, and Remote Log Viewer live view
Fixed ----- - The multi-run parent farming loop could report "Could not return to career selection" and stop, for two separate reasons: (1) its success check matched the Legacy Select screen prematurely (it shares an Auto-Select button graphic with Support Formation) and returned before actually advancing past it, and (2) a single slow post-Complete Career "Now Loading" transition could by itself exceed the old 90s navigation deadline before any navigation was even attempted. Widened the deadline (90s->240s, 180s->360s with Breeding Plan) and gave this loop the same Legacy Select recovery logic the per-turn loop already had. - The in-game "Quick Mode Settings" popup (shown the first time you tap the Quick training-skip toggle) was never detectable by the bot at all — the dialog-handling code for it existed but was never registered, so the bot would sit in front of it indefinitely. Now properly registered and dismissed.
Added ----- - The Remote Log Viewer now has a "Live View" panel showing a live video feed of the current run, streamed over the same local server used for the real-time log stream. - New "Auto-equip support deck" setting (Parent Farming Settings > Career selection) that taps the Support Formation screen's own Auto-Select to fill owned support-card deck slots, independent from legacy-parent auto-select.
